User Requirement / Reported Issue: Left UI image moves on scroll in login page
Error Behavior Before Fix: Student photograph and streak badge scrolled away on short screens
Root Cause: .auth-page used min-height: 100vh without overflow: hidden causing body scroll
Remediated Fix Applied: Set .auth-page & .auth-visual to height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; isolated scroll to .auth-panel

User Requirement / Reported Issue: Login / verification code must not be visible at bottom
Error Behavior Before Fix: 4-digit code was visible under OTP boxes as Preview code: 2468
Root Cause: Preview helper buttons and preview_code field in API response
Remediated Fix Applied: Removed preview code buttons; removed preview_code from backend API

User Requirement / Reported Issue: Remove sample student demo login chip
Error Behavior Before Fix: Sample login bar with 1-Click Login bypass was exposed on form
Root Cause: Demo shortcut component rendered in stage login
Remediated Fix Applied: Completely removed demo-chip-bar; all logins require genuine credentials

User Requirement / Reported Issue: Verification code must send to the email
Error Behavior Before Fix: OTP was not guaranteed to arrive and bypass allowed proceeding
Remediated Fix Applied: Removed development bypass; enforced live dispatch via Gmail SMTP (smtp.gmail.com:587)

User Requirement / Reported Issue: If mail already exists say that account exists
Error Behavior Before Fix: Registering with existing email bypassed error and went to Step 2/3
Root Cause: Catch block swallowed 400 error and defaulted to next step
Remediated Fix Applied: Added strict check on Step 1 and Step 2; halts with account already exists error

User Requirement / Reported Issue: After sign in person must login (no auto-login)
Error Behavior Before Fix: Verifying OTP automatically logged user directly into dashboard
Root Cause: submitVerification stored JWT and called success directly
Remediated Fix Applied: Removed auto-login tokens; redirects user to Sign In with success notice

User Requirement / Reported Issue: All fields must not be filled previously - no defaults
Error Behavior Before Fix: Signup preferences form had pre-selected values
Root Cause: React state initialized with hardcoded defaults
Remediated Fix Applied: Initialized all state to empty strings and empty arrays; added empty select placeholder

User Requirement / Reported Issue: Your profile photo is not needed in this page
Error Behavior Before Fix: Step 1 showed unwanted profile photo upload card above form
Root Cause: Component avatar-upload was included in signup-personal
Remediated Fix Applied: Completely deleted avatar-upload component from Step 1

Error Behavior Before Fix: Risk of passwords < 10 chars or case-insensitive matching
Remediated Fix Applied: Enforced client minLength={10}; backend len >= 10; bcrypt.checkpw case-sensitivity

User Requirement / Reported Issue: Forgot password must work only for registered users
Error Behavior Before Fix: Unregistered emails could request OTPs and waste resources
Root Cause: Backend allowed OTP generation before checking user existence
Remediated Fix Applied: Added pre-check in /api/auth/send-otp; returns 404 User does not exist

User Requirement / Reported Issue: Sign In failing / not responding on login submission
Error Behavior Before Fix: Submitting login resulted in hang or timeout
Root Cause: vite.config.ts proxy targeted sleeping Render instance instead of local backend
Remediated Fix Applied: Launched active Aarva backend on port 8001; updated Vite proxy target to 127.0.0.1:8001

User Requirement / Reported Issue: 'Server is starting up (Render free tier)' error during login
Error Behavior Before Fix: Form displayed Render free tier startup error whenever local backend was stopped or proxy returned non-JSON HTML
Root Cause: apiPost blindly threw Render cold-start message on any JSON parse error; port mismatch between backend and proxy
Remediated Fix Applied: Synced backend and Vite proxy on standard port 8000; added ECONNREFUSED check and automated cold-start retry

User Requirement / Reported Issue: Comprehensive Auth Hardening: Signup Login Verification and OTP Patches
Error Behavior Before Fix: OTP verification lacked brute-force limits; signup was callable without verified OTP check; OTP generation lacked spam cooldown; timing attack vulnerability
Root Cause: Unrestricted OTP verification attempts; missing verification token gate on /signup; pseudo-random OTP generation; plain string equality comparison on OTP
Remediated Fix Applied: Implemented secrets cryptographic OTP generation; constant-time compare_digest; max 5 attempt lockout; 30s resend cooldown; strict is_email_verified gate on /signup
